title: Got a 4.3 spam rejection on Apple. Do you keep shipping updates or freeze everything?
author: BrownaroStudios
selftext:
Two of our new apps got rejected under 4.3(a) about 10 days ago. We replied the same day and haven't heard anything back. The notice also warned that more submissions could slow review down for the whole account.

So we froze everything. No updates to our live games either, and they're piling up.

This happened once before in August. Four updates got flagged after a busy week, and after we replied they went back into review in about a day. Both times we'd sent a lot at once, so I think pace was the trigger.

Now I'm thinking of sending one update at a time, a week apart, and holding any new apps.

Has anyone kept updating live games while a 4.3 was open? Did it hurt, or was it fine?

comments.author: JudeWorks
comments.body:
Hello,

I had 2 new apps get this same warning (not games but probably doesnt matter). I have submitted a few updates since to existing apps without issue since.  I am considering submitted another app but am sort of waiting for more data points on best practice here.

replies.author: BrownaroStudios
replies.body: We've halted all our apps even for updates while we wait for it to clear.  Are you talking about submitting updates after the rejections were cleared or while you were waiting for them to clear?

replies.author: JudeWorks
replies.body: I’m just updating apps that have already been approved doing the typical incremental updates. I’m not touching the rejected ones as of right now.

comments.author: ex0rius
comments.body: How many apps do you have on your account?
